intent_en: Compare the shares of adults with and without college education across the six income brackets and identify where the without-college share is highest.
narration_support: Canceling the country's student debt won't help them at all. But for Sanders and Warren, this is part of a larger belief about what America should be. Right now we have an economy in the 21st century that basically says you're going to need some post -high school training.
